summary: handleGetStructure builds the gs symbol page for one file. Uses findFileByPath to lookup file: returns [fileId, IndexedFile] if found, null if not indexed. Distinguishes two states: null → file not in index (untracked), [fileId, file with file.symbols=[]] → file indexed but has zero symbols (e.g., CSS). Handles match filtering, symbol slicing, imports/importers, callers per symbol. Critical for kb write reuse: can call loadCachedIndex('gs') then index.files.get(path) to check presence.

Builds the gs page. findFileByPath distinguishes two states: null = not indexed, [fileId, file with symbols=[]] = indexed but symbol-less (e.g. CSS). It is SYNCHRONOUS and takes the index only, which is why the git-derived co-change data arrives as an optional THIRD parameter loaded by each caller rather than off the index — see [[how-the-moves-together-signal-reaches-gs-without-going-through-the-index]]. Section order matters: co-change is computed BEFORE Related so its picks can be added to Related's excludeIds, otherwise the same path prints under two headings.

facets.detail: Builds the gs page. findFileByPath distinguishes two states: null = not indexed, [fileId, file with symbols=[]] = indexed but symbol-less (e.g. CSS). It is SYNCHRONOUS and takes the index only, which is why the git-derived co-change data arrives as an optional THIRD parameter loaded by each caller rather than off the index. Sections are gated by `view` via wantSymbols/wantImports/wantImporters — but co-change is NOT: it renders in every view, because the one real session that needed it asked for `--view symbols` on a god-file and the section was unreachable. Its exclusion set therefore reads index.outEdges/inEdges directly rather than importsOut/importersShown, which narrow views never populate and full view truncates at IMPORTERS_LIST_CAP. Co-change is still computed BEFORE Related so its picks feed Related's excludeIds.
